out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK being used TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS AND BRUSHES.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED ITEMS FROM HANDWASH SINK AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in the 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW TURKEY PATTIES STORED OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed ICE SCOOP PLACED IN the handsink at the END OF COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED SCOOP TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sinks: AT END OF COOK LINE AND NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC BROUGHT SOAP FOR WASHING HANDS ON ARRIVAL.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: FOOD PANS AND UTENSILS BEING WASHED AT START OF INSPECTION. FACILITY HAD NO SANITIZER AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC BROUGHT CHLORINE SANITIZER ON ARRIVAL. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PREPARE SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION AND HAVE DISHES SANITIZED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BEAN BURGER PATTY AT 44F, SPINACH BURGER PATTY AT 44F, MILK AT 48F IN NOTHERN AMERICAN 2 DOOR FLAT TOP; VARIOUS SLICED CHEESE AT 48F, FETA AT 51F, BEEF BURGER PATTY AT 50F, RAW MARINATED CHICKEN AT 49F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. TCS FOODS HELD FOR LESS THAN 4 HOURS IN UNITS WERE TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: 2 TRAYS OF BREAD STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO RELOCATE BREAD TRAYS TO DOLLY DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: NORTHERN AMERICAN 2 DOOR FLAT TOP AT 46F AND NORTHERN AMERICAN 2 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER (GRILL) AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE DO NOT STORE FOODS REQUIRING TIME OR TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY (TCS) IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE/BLEACH test kit. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED CFM WAS NOT ON SITE AT THE START OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM CAME DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THAT AT CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): OBSERVED SLICED TOMATOES, SHREDDED CHEESE AND CUT LETTUCE IN 2 DOOR PREP USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL WITHOUT WRITTEN PROCEDURES.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED TIME LABELS ON FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE IS MAINTAINED.
